note: An octave siren over a drone, then the high Do held for one breath. The three keys of the old Key choice are now moves (key any, first in G), so the app brings a higher key; the line about another key opens with {{?key}} and says what stays, and the one care line keeps the top note easy.

exercise.title: An octave slide, a little higher
exercise.why: A slide passes through every pitch on the way up, so your voice arrives at the top note already moving instead of jumping at it.

cells.text:
Press Start exercise below: the drone and the mic start together, and your pitch shows as a line on the staff. Slide slowly from the low {{1}} up to the high {{1}} and back, like a siren. Sing it on "oo".
Then slide up once more and hold the high {{1}} quietly for one breath.
Practice until the held {{1}} stays steady without pushing.
{{?key}}In a higher key the slide ends higher, and it is still one octave from the low {{1}} to the high {{1}}.
_Don't reach for high notes by pushing: go only as high as stays easy today._
